about.meta_title: About Veta — Physical Training for Football Players
about.meta_description: Meet the team behind Veta, the physical training app for football players.
about.section1_content:
At Veta we believe in real improvement. Not comfort, not generic plans, not another app that just wants you to feel good for a few minutes so you come back tomorrow.
We want you to perform better.
We are convinced that most amateur footballers train without direction. Not knowing if what they're doing makes sense for their position, their match schedule, their body.
Veta doesn't work that way.
It's not designed to give you a routine copied from the internet. It's built to tell you what needs to be done, when it needs to be done.
And that, in this world, is not common. Nor easy. But it's what's needed.
about.section2_content:
Playing in an amateur team, I realized I was training without direction. Not knowing if what I was doing made sense for my position, my matches, my body. Everything I found was generic or made for professionals.
That's when the need arose to create something different. Not something that helps you get in shape, but something that helps you perform better on the pitch.
That's how Veta was born.
Not as a product. But as a personal need that became collective.
about.section3_content:
I've played in amateur teams for years. I know what it's like to train hard and arrive at the match tired from work, or to not know if the exercises you're doing even make sense for your position.
I've launched projects that didn't work out the way I wanted. I know what frustration feels like, what laziness feels like, and the thought that maybe you're not as good as you think.
And that's why I know what's needed, because I've lived it.
I believe Veta can be the tool that helps you perform better without needing a personal coach. It doesn't promise you'll sign for Madrid. It prepares you to deserve a spot in the starting eleven.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy and data protection policy for the Veta app, physical training for football players.
privacy.intro: we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our app, and outlines your rights under applicable data protection laws.
privacy.s1_intro: When you use the Veta app, we may collect the following information:
privacy.s1_li1: Personal Data: such as your email address if you register or contact us.
privacy.s1_li2: Training Data: playing position, level, availability, and physical goals you enter when setting up your plan.
privacy.s1_li3: Usage Data: information about your interactions with the app (sessions completed, device type, operating system).
privacy.s1_highlight: Important note: Veta provides physical training plans tailored for football. It does not replace the supervision of a qualified doctor or physiotherapist. If you have any injury or health condition, consult a professional before starting any training program.
privacy.s2_li1: Generate and personalize your physical training plan based on your position and level.
privacy.s2_li2: Adapt workouts to your team training days and match calendar.
privacy.s2_li3: Track your progress, streak, and performance metrics.
privacy.s2_li4: Improve app performance and user experience.
privacy.s2_li5: Send notifications related to the app's operation.
privacy.s3_content: We use encryption and industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. All user data is handled confidentially and securely.
privacy.s4_content: Veta may use cookies or similar technologies to enhance user experience. You can manage or disable cookies in your device settings, though some app features may not function properly if you do so.
privacy.s5_intro: We do not share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:
privacy.s5_li1: When required by law or legal processes.
privacy.s5_li2: When working with trusted service providers (such as hosting or analytics) who comply with strict data protection standards.
privacy.s6_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
privacy.s6_r1_desc: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s6_r2_desc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.s6_r3_desc: Request that your data be deleted, unless required by law.
privacy.s6_r4_desc: Object to data processing for certain purposes.
privacy.s6_r5_desc: Request limitation of data use under specific circumstances.
privacy.s6_r6_desc: Request your data in a structured, portable format.
privacy.s6_contact: To exercise your rights, please contact us at info@vetaapp.com.
privacy.s7_content: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to provide the service. You may request deletion of your data at any time, and we will erase or anonymize it according to applicable law.
privacy.s8_content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted within the app or on our website, with the revised date indicated at the top.
privacy.s9_content: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, contact us at info@vetaapp.com.
privacy.legal_note: This policy complies with international data protection laws, including the GDPR (Europe) and applicable privacy regulations.
privacy.help_desc: We're here to answer your questions about privacy and data protection.
